name: Box huckleberry
desc: Box huckleberry (Gaylussacia brachycera): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Gaylussacia brachycera, commonly known as box huckleberry or box-leaved whortleberry, is a low North American shrub related to the blueberry and the other huckleberries.
